product_metadata.title: Sorfey Vinyl Picnic Table and Bench Fitted Tablecloth Cover, Checkered Design, Flannel Backed Lining, 28 x 72 Inch, 3-Piece Set, Blue
features: FITTED TABLECLOTH FOR SECURE FIT- The Sorfey Picnic Table & Bench Tablecloths were designed to stay on the table even under windy weather, so that nothing keeps you back from enjoying your outdoors dining. Set includes: 1 Table cover (for 28" X 72" picnic tables) and 2 Bench Seat Covers (for 12" X 72" benches).

THICK, ELASTIC, STRETCHABLE DESIGN- Enjoy the perfect, snug fit for picnic tables, trade show tables or any folding table. The smartly incorporated elastic, stretchable corners will keep our table and bench cloths put, no matter what- no more messy accidents when the wind blows, no more tugging or pulling around the table and NO CLIPS NEEDED.

HEAVY DUTY, WATERPROOF VINYL CONSTRUCTION- The tablecloth and bench cloths are made with heavy duty vinyl that is waterproof, stain resistant, spill-proof and easy to clean. Under the vinyl, our cloths are reinforced with soft flannel backing so that they do not slip off or skid while using.

CASSIC CHECKEDESIGN- The Sorfey tablecloth set comes with a classic checkedesign to add that familiar feeling of a rustic, hearty get together. Our cloths are the perfect choice that effortlessly blends into any backdrop whether you’re with family or at a professional booth- use for picnics, BBQs, garden lounging, beach, parks- whether indoors or outdoors, our tablecloths enhance any dining experience.
